Established: Conrey-Li's two counterexamples reproduce and zero 34 is the first failure of (N2) at h=1; the entire-function condition implies zeros on the line and cos Delta_h >= 0 at every zero; the weight-form condition with shift h implies Delta_h = 0 mod 2 pi at every boundary zero, which fails at the first zeros for h = 1, 0.25, 0.1 (measured); the (a,h) weight family is false for every conclusion half-plane sigma_0 <= 1 relative to Bohr's density theorem (recalled, not opened); V1a = T3 and V2 = G6 are restatements; a lattice-zero function satisfies all hypotheses and necessary conditions, and DH on-line zeros fail like zeta. obstruction: Stage A. The (a,h) weight family is false for every conclusion half-plane sigma_0 <= 1 relative to Bohr (recalled). V1a = T3 and V2 = G6 are restatements. No Euler-product step. Not established: every-h failure in the entire-function form, tied conductor family V3b, attribution of the failure to the Euler product.

lesson: Shift-accretivity conditions of de Branges type test bounded imbalance of zeros at a fixed scale at every zero. The Euler product (independence of p^it) is what violates this, so the device runs against R1. Contractivity of the same shift is the classical Hermite-Biehler property and is RH-neutral. Backward heat was not evaluated at the zeta-failing step; no failure at h <= 0.5 was measured below 1e4.
